predecessorFullReset.branchStatus: deleted after successor publication to prevent accidental merge

oneShotMainThreadStall.interpretation: A one-shot wall-clock busy loop blocks both rAF and rVFC. It tests recovery but did not isolate queue-capacity handling in these runs.

capacityPressureEvidence.scope: Test-only one-field presentation policy plus every-other-rAF injection. The successor uses the same minimum-FIFO versus future-clock reset queue algorithm, but does not include the presentation-policy change or test hook.

excludedRuns.reason: The production predecessor and successor builds did not contain the global test hook, so setting the flag injected no presentation throttling. These are ordinary-playback observations, not forced-presentation evidence.

conclusion: The successor preserved the predecessor stall fix in 90 alternating seeks and normal/film cadence. Its capacity behavior is supported by the isolated diagnostic build; one-shot main-thread stalls recovered in both variants and did not independently demonstrate a speedup.
